input.summary: Remove the three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment; Customer pays only for Services ordered or used.
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept minimum purchase or take-or-pay commitments, so we have replaced the three-year USD 2,000,000 commitment with payment for Services actually ordered or used; this also removes the conflict with our termination-for-convenience right in Section 9.4 and the no-minimum-volume acknowledgement in Section 12.3. If a commitment is commercially essential, we could consider one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice and trued-up rather than penalised.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer has no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or volume commitment. Customer pays only for Services ordered under a signed Order Form and usage actually incurred, and Customer's termination and reduction rights under this Agreement are unaffected.
